To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
conflict engagement is a key factor in the success of small to medium-sized organisations.

the majority of the respondents (70%) reported that they were satisfied with the conflict engagement in their organization, and that the majority of them also indicated that their organization has an effective conflict management system (70%) and an effective conflict engagement strategy (60%).

the majority of small and medium-sized organisations in the UK do not have a conflict management system in place and, when they do have one, it is usually informal, reactive, and based on a traditional, non-systematic approach to conflict engagement.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the role and function of the HR manager in small to medium-sized businesses, and the way in which HR managers can be more effective in their role by adopting a contingency approach to conflict management.
the way in which conflict is engaged with and managed in small and medium-sized organisations.
the ways in which managers and employees in small and medium-sized organisations engage with conflict.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
conflict is a natural part of human interaction.
there is no one best approach to conflict engagement, as it will vary from organisation to organisation and situation to situation, but that there are certain principles which should be followed.
the contingency approach to conflict engagement is an important and useful tool for managers and HR practitioners to utilise in their organisations.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have found a contingency approach to conflict engagement in the  workplace, particularly in small and medium-sized organisations.
we have found that conflict engagement can be a positive experience in the workplace.
the more you engage with conflict, the more you learn about yourself and the more you can grow as a person.

the best conflict engagement strategy depends on the situation.
the way in which we engage with conflict in the workplace is not necessarily the same way we engage with conflict outside the workplace.
